event.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
event.summary: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio and plans to combine its drug-development coordination platform with OpenAI’s Rosalind models and tools for life-sciences research.

facts.label: Acquisition
facts.text: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio, a drug-development coordination platform.

facts.label: Integration
facts.text: OpenAI is bringing Orchestra’s team and technology together with Rosalind.
facts.quote: We're bringing Orchestra's team and technology together with Rosalind, our AI models and tools for life sciences research.
